description: Send a suggested, failed or partial answer, optionally with edited text: reply/dm replace the drafted texts, null drops that part. Goes out within a minute; parts already sent never repeat. A drafted DM past Instagram's 7 days drops on its own when the public reply can go alone.

dm.description: Edited DM text; null drops the DM; omit to send the draft as is

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

reply.description: Edited public reply text, e.g. "Thanks, it's in the link in bio!"; null drops the public reply; omit to send the draft as is

reply_id.description: ID of the drafted answer (a UUID): from comments_to_answer or comment_replies_list

name: comment_reply_send
title: Send an answer
